actions.rationale: Install the staged mod: the review batch (respawn fallback, autopilot y-band, ladderFoot, hills/console/disposers/lamps/palette/tower/cranes/backs, the two deck hunters, objHold); ladders robust at low frame rates (S takes a ladder anywhere over its hatch, a fast fall is caught whatever is held, a taken ladder holds its climber over the whole hatch, left/right ignored while climbing); soldiers well off camera hidden for the render only; the cliff tunnel and bunker lower corridor at 175 px headroom; measuring hooks (far, setsOf, charsDrawnAll). Static lint of the staged level: ok, 0 violations, nothing unreachable, 7 caps with cover, no low fight ceilings.
actions.predictedEffect: mods/cs-coastal-tower.user.js replaced by the staged build.

actions.rationale: The play probe, honest: put() stills every body the character has (a teleport kept the boat's momentum); the water climb keeps a trail and must also work swimming in from 130 px; the descent is strict (from beside the hatch, S held, ladder taken over the hole and kept to its foot, no free fall); each console must take its full hold; respawn within 8 s and within 150 px of the checkpoint; only live crewed patrols count as moving.
actions.predictedEffect: tools/harness/levels/play-06.js replaced by the stricter probe.

actions.rationale: The pathing probe waited with the player dead or in the boat: take the player out of any vehicle, still it, heal it every frame (fire bypasses the ragdoll damage hook), and check it stayed within 160 px of the bait on foot the whole 20 s — else the probe fails rather than reads a count.
actions.predictedEffect: tools/harness/levels/waypoints.js replaced; its report carries player{first,last,deaths,worst,inVehicle} and playerHeld.
